import sys

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    a1, a2, a3 = map(int, input[1:4])
    b1, b2, b3 = map(int, input[4:7])

    min_wins = max(0, a1 - b2) + max(0, a2 - b3) + max(0, a3 - b1)
    max_wins = min(a1, b3) + min(a2, b1) + min(a3, b2)

    print(min_wins, max_wins)
